label: TCL Google TV (Android 11-14)

extra_checks.cmd: appops get io.freemytv AUTO_START || appops get io.freemytv APP_AUTO_START
extra_checks.fix: adb shell appops set io.freemytv AUTO_START allow

notes: TclAppBoot drops manifest broadcasts and blocks ModeJob binding; the app runs the mode job in-process and keeps its adhan receiver in :home. Do not change that without a TCL test.
